Last night, she had suffered what we believe to be a sudden heart attack, and she passed away; we have literally no idea how it happened as she was very well taken care of, and she was perfectly fine earlier yesterday. Both of us are devastated right now and grieving, especially my fiance as she has been having severe depression the past few weeks, so this doesn't help her at all. We said our goodbyes, and let her Today as i am playing video games, i overhear her making phone calls to pet shops and animal shelters asking for birds they have. She got annoyed with me and told me it would help her feel better and to grieve. We argued back and forth for a bit. My fiance called me an asshole and said i have no say in the matter, which i feel as though i do because i pay the rent and bills in our apartment, money is super tight cause i am the only one working right now, and it would be my money that pays for this bird (we have separate accounts).
